title: items.json
description: Stage 1.5 structure analysis output: every content blob in the book with line-precise boundaries, plus the Stage 1.6 `derived` overlay of formalizable claims found inside those blobs.

partitionItem.description: A member of the text partition: a contiguous span of book text. Every line of every page belongs to exactly one of these.

id.description: Unique identifier, e.g. Chapter3/Theorem3.1 or Frontmatter/Preface

start_page.description: Logical page name matching pages/*.md filename without extension

end_page.description: Logical page name matching pages/*.md filename without extension

derivedItem.description: An overlay on the partition, not a member of it: a formalizable claim discovered inside an existing blob. Keyed by `derived_from` rather than `id`, carries no line span, and is skipped by the contiguity check.

derived_from.description: The `id` of the partition item this claim was found inside

source_span.description: The exact quoted sentence from the book, for provenance

claim.description: One-line normalized statement of the claim

status.description: Triage/formalization status, e.g. accepted, sorry_free, rejected_duplicate, rejected_trivial, rejected_nonformal, rejected_already_covered
